date_range_basis: Calendar coverage of the prepared monthly tables; monthly aviation stamps in 2022 are not individual flight dates.
notes: model_status extends the originally proposed enum; evaluation does not imply benchmark superiority.
Data files include all available history. Model fitting stops at the frozen cutoff.
Null means missing, withheld, unsupported or undefined; related flags distinguish the reason.
baseline_prediction means the regression baseline; seasonal_benchmark_prediction is separate.
Load factor and coverage are percentages; P2P/transfer/transit/new-arrival shares are fractions.
Forecasts, scenario assumptions and exploratory correlations must remain separately labelled in the UI.
